name: Iori Maya
source:
A second-year student at Chloe Women's High School.
She is smart and talented, but also a natural-born young lady who doesn't let those facts get in the way of her personality.

She's never been outside of her all-girls school, so she is a bit naive.

She is quite the clumsy individual.

[translated from [url=https://www.pandora.nu/az/wakaba_top.html]official website[/url]]
